name: An equity ETF's Vorabpauschale, next to a 75,000 salary
workings: The ETF was worth 100,000 at the start (108,000 / 1.08) and rose 8%
Base income: 100,000 × 3.20% × 70% = 2,240.00, below the 8,000 rise: the Vorabpauschale is 2,240.00
Flat tax 25% × 568 = 142.00; Soli 5.5% = 7.81. The salary's marginal rate (38%) is above 25%, so the tariff isn't lower
The 2,240 is added to the purchase cost, so it isn't taxed again on sale
The salary's income tax as in employee-75k
Changed from the draft: the draft's person had no other income, for whom the Günstigerprüfung taxes the 568 at the tariff, at 0
